title: Macroscopic Black-Hole Remnants in a Nonlocal Field Theory: Towards Hawking Radiation in SFT
summary: We demonstrate that, for a large black hole of radius $a$, Hawking radiation terminates around the scrambling time $u_{\text{scr}} \equiv 2a \log(a/\ell)$ due to the nonlocal, exponential suppression of trans-Planckian interactions inherent in string field theory (SFT). Modifying a massless scalar field's interaction with a dynamical black hole background via the smearing operator $e^{\ell^2\Box}$ (where $\ell$ denotes the string length scale), we calculate the time-dependent number expectation value $\langle \hat{N}(u) \rangle$ of outgoing Hawking particles at retarded time $u$.
